name: Household visits
about: {table} becomes the form's table, e.g. p1_household_visit. Cards count approved submissions only. Grid is 24 columns wide.

cards.name: Visits
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS visits FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Households visited
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT household_id) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Head of household met
cards.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN met_head = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) || '%' AS met FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Waiting for review
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM {table} WHERE review_state IN ('received', 'edited')

cards.name: Visits per week
cards.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', submitted_at)::date AS week, count(*) AS visits FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Main source of income now
cards.sql: SELECT main_income_now, count(*) AS visits FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Latest visits
cards.sql: SELECT submitted_at, household_id, village, met_head, people_present, main_income_now, submitted_by FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 50
